notes: Convert a finished file: take the sound out as MP3 or M4A, or rewrap a video as MP4. Where it cannot be done, it says why rather than hiding the option · Every format, not three: a More… beside the quality tiles lists everything a page offers, with its codec, frame rate and size · It warns which ones your phone would decode in software — a smaller file that makes the phone hot is the worse answer, and only Rabbit is in a position to say so · Picking a video-only stream now takes its sound with it · Site rules: import one for a site Rabbit does not know yet. Yours survive the daily refresh, and only yours can be removed · A failed page can be reported. It shows what would be sent, then opens your browser at a filled-in issue — it never sends anything itself · Every word in the app now lives in one file, which is what any translation has to start from. Counts read properly too — "1 file", "3 files" · Fixed: several places decided what to do by reading English text off the screen. The settings pages would all have broken in any other language
